apps.name: 3D Printer Status
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Your 3D printer at a glance: how far the print is, the time left and when it will be done, the nozzle and bed temperatures, and a chime when it finishes. For OctoPrint and Klipper (Mainsail, Fluidd) on your own network.

apps.name: Air, UV & Pollen
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Today's outdoor conditions where you live: the air quality index, the UV index with the hours to wear sunscreen, and grass, tree and weed pollen (in Europe). Free Open-Meteo data, no key needed.

apps.name: Airport Weather
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: An airport's official weather, decoded: the flight category (VFR, MVFR, IFR, LIFR), wind on a compass with gusts, visibility, clouds, temperature and pressure, the forecast (TAF) ahead, and the raw reports. From aviationweather.gov, free, for up to three airports.

apps.name: Baby Countdown
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: A countdown to your baby's due date for the whole family: the days to go, and if you like the week, the baby's size and your appointments. Shows as little as you choose, and stops with one tap.

apps.name: Bell Schedule
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: The school day at a glance: the lesson now with the time left, what comes next, and how long until break, lunch or home time. A timetable for each weekday, with a chime at each bell.

apps.name: Big Clock
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: The time in big digits, in a style you choose, with the date, seconds and your alarms. Or the clock alone, or the calendar alone, large enough to read across a room.

apps.name: Brain Break
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: A short movement break when the class needs one: a moving figure shows each activity (star jumps, stretches, dance and freeze) with a countdown, and the break ends with slow breathing. Seated activities for small rooms.

apps.name: Branch Rates
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: A rates board for a bank branch or bureau de change: what the bank buys and sells each currency at, and its savings and deposit rates, in turn on the screen. Type the rates on the phone, or give a link the bank's system keeps up to date.

apps.name: Breathe
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Guided breathing: a shape on the panel grows as you breathe in and shrinks as you breathe out, for one to ten minutes. Box breathing, 4-7-8, slow breathing or a longer breath out, with soft tones if you like.

apps.name: Build Status
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Your team's GitHub Actions and GitLab pipelines at a glance: passing, failing or running, on which branch, by whom and when. A broken build sounds an alarm; fixing it gets a cheer.

apps.name: Business Counters
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Your numbers on the desk: YouTube subscribers, GitHub stars, and sales from Stripe, Paystack or Shopify.

apps.name: Busy Light
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: A sign for your door: busy, free or in a meeting, by hand or from your Google or Outlook calendar and your Teams status.

apps.name: Calm Corner
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: For children of 4 to 10: a quiet place to say how they feel, and to calm down with breathing, things to see and hear, slow stretches, or calm lights with soft notes. You can see their feelings on the phone.

apps.name: Catholic Daily
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Today's liturgical day from the General Roman Calendar in its colour, the Angelus (Regina Caeli in Eastertide), the Hour of Mercy, the Rosary's mysteries of the day and a Douay-Rheims verse.

apps.name: Chess
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: A live game from Lichess TV on the board as it is played: the moves, the players, their ratings and clocks, and the result, then the next game. Add your Lichess name for a page of your ratings. No key needed.

apps.name: Cloud Cost Meter
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: This month's cloud bill so far, from AWS, DigitalOcean, Akamai (Linode) or your own JSON address: up to four accounts, the total, where the month is heading, and each budget. A chime when an account heads over its budget.

apps.name: Code Quest
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: For children of 6 to 12: a first taste of programming. Build a program from blocks with the knob, then watch the robot run it. 16 levels, each needing a new idea.

apps.name: CoinCap Crypto
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Your crypto watchlist from CoinCap: prices, 24-hour change, a 7-day chart, market numbers, supply, the top gainers and crypto news, paced to your CoinCap plan's credits. Needs your CoinCap key.

apps.name: CoinMarketCap Crypto
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Your crypto watchlist from CoinMarketCap with your own API key: prices, changes from an hour to 90 days, a 7-day chart where your plan has history, the whole market, Fear & Greed and the day's biggest movers. It reads your plan's credits and paces itself to them.

apps.name: Commute
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: How long the drive or the ride to work takes now, from TomTom, Google or transit timetables, with when to leave.

apps.name: Cricket Live
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Live cricket: runs, wickets and overs for every innings, what the chasing side needs, and today's matches and results, with your team first. A wicket in your team's match gets a call. From CricketData.org with your free key.

apps.name: Currency Exchange
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Exchange rates between the currencies you pick, with a converter and the change since yesterday.

apps.name: Daily Bible
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: A Bible verse every day, a reading plan with a streak, the church year from Advent to Pentecost, and reminders for your devotions and Sunday service.

apps.name: Events Directory
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Today's events, conferences and weddings for a hotel or venue lobby: each with its time, room and an arrow showing the way, what's on now marked. From the events calendar (an iCal link) or events typed on the phone.

apps.name: Exam Clock
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: For tests and exams: the time left in large figures, the start and finish times, reading time, warnings at 30, 15 and 5 minutes, extra time for those who have it, and the room's rules in turn. Pause it if the exam is interrupted.

apps.name: Finnhub Stocks
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: A stock market terminal for your watchlist: live prices, the session chart, returns, fundamentals, the 52-week range, analysts, earnings and news, from Finnhub. Needs your free Finnhub key.

apps.name: Flight Board
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: An airport's departures or arrivals on a split-flap board: time, flight, destination, gate and status (on time, delayed, boarding, departed, cancelled). From AeroDataBox, with your own RapidAPI key (its free plan updates the board a few times a day).

apps.name: Focus List
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Today's to-do list with a focus timer: work on one task for a set time, then take a break. Pixlpal counts the minutes on each task. Write the tasks on the phone; tick them off with the knob.

apps.name: Follower Counter
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Your follower counts as big numbers that roll up when they change: YouTube subscribers (your own key), GitHub followers and stars, Bluesky and Mastodon followers. Up to four, with today's gain and confetti at each milestone.

apps.name: FX Markets
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Live currency pairs and their day's moves, from Massive (formerly Polygon.io). Needs your Massive key.

apps.name: Gate Display
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: A gate or check-in sign for airline staff: the flight, destination, time and gate, and the call in large letters (boarding by group, final call, gate closed, delayed) with a chime at each change. One click moves boarding along. No internet needed.

apps.name: Glucose Display
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Your glucose from Dexcom, FreeStyle Libre (LibreLinkUp) or your own Nightscout site, with its trend and alarms on Pixlpal and your phone.

apps.name: GNews Headlines
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Headlines by topic or country from GNews, as cards or a list. Needs your free GNews key.

apps.name: Google Weather
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: The weather from Google: now, by the hour and the coming days, with alerts. Needs your Google Maps Platform key.

apps.name: Guest Welcome
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: A personal welcome in the guest's room: their name and room number, a Wi-Fi code their phone can scan to join, checkout time, breakfast hours and the hotel's message of the day. It dims to a quiet clock at night.

apps.name: House Points
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: A live scoreboard for houses or teams: each house's colour bar and total, the leader crowned, and a cheer whenever points are given. Give points from the phone or with the knob; this week's points and the term's are kept.

apps.name: HSE Board
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: A site safety board readable across the room: days without a lost-time injury and the best record, injuries, first aid cases, near misses and observations, LTIFR and TRIFR, the message of the week and safety signs. For factories, oil and gas, mining, construction, facilities and warehouses.

apps.name: ISS Tracker
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: The International Space Station on a world map with day and night: where it is, its track ahead, and when it passes over your place, with the passes you can see with your own eyes. No key needed.

apps.name: Kids Learning
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Maths that follows how your child is doing, a times-tables race, spelling they hear and spell, a reading timer, and games they earn by learning. For ages 4 to 12, with a time limit and bedtime you set.

apps.name: Kobo Terminal
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Nigerian stocks and their news from Kobo Terminal, with the market's movers. Needs your Kobo Terminal key.

apps.name: League Table
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Your football league on the panel: the table with points, goal difference and form, the top scorers, and this round's results and fixtures, with your team highlighted. Premier League, La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga and more.

apps.name: Life & Automata
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Living patterns that grow, move and die by simple rules: Conway's Game of Life, HighLife, Day & Night, Seeds, Maze, Brian's Brain and the one-line rules 30, 90 and 110. It seeds itself again when a world settles. Works offline.

apps.name: Live Football
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Live scores with goal celebrations, today's matches, yesterday's results and your team's next kick-off, from API-Football. Needs your API-Football key.

apps.name: Loan & Savings Calculator
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: A calculator customers use with the knob while they wait: choose a loan, an amount and a term, and see the monthly payment, the interest and the total to repay; or a monthly saving and see what it grows to. The bank sets its products and rates on the phone.

apps.name: Message Board
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Messages sent to a topic of yours on ntfy appear on Pixlpal, from your phone, a script or a home automation.

apps.name: Motorsport Live
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Formula 1 live: the race order, the gaps, the weekend's sessions and the standings, from OpenF1.

apps.name: My First Computer
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: A pretend computer for children of 4 to 12, to learn the mouse, the keyboard, windows, files and staying safe online, with nothing that can go wrong. Plug a USB mouse and keyboard into Pixlpal.

apps.name: My Flight
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Follows your flight from home or the hotel: status, terminal and gate, any delay, when to leave for the airport, the countdown to boarding, the flight's progress in the air, and the baggage belt when it lands. From AeroDataBox, with your own RapidAPI key.

apps.name: My Training
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Your week from Strava: distance against a weekly goal, time and climbing, a bar for each day, and your latest run or ride with its pace. Runs, rides, walks and swims, in kilometres or miles.

apps.name: Name Picker
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Picks who answers next: the class's names spin and land on one, and nobody is picked twice until everyone has had a turn. It also splits the class into random groups or pairs.

apps.name: News API
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Top headlines by country, category or source from NewsAPI.org. Needs your NewsAPI key.

apps.name: NGX Market
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: The Nigerian Exchange: the stocks you follow, the day's movers and charts. Needs your NGN Market key.

apps.name: Now & Next
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: A picture routine for young pupils and special-needs classrooms: what we are doing now, in a large picture with a bar of the time left, and what comes next. Calm, clear changes from one activity to the next.

apps.name: Oil Price
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Brent and WTI crude prices with their charts and the week's news, from the U.S. Energy Information Administration. Needs your free EIA key.

apps.name: Oil Price API
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Crude oil, gas and fuel prices as they move, with charts, from OilPriceAPI. Needs your OilPriceAPI key.

apps.name: On This Day
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: What happened on today's date in history, from Wikipedia's front page: each event with its year, who was born and who died, and the day's observances. No key needed.

apps.name: On-Call Board
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Your team's open incidents from PagerDuty or incident.io and who is on call, readable across the room. A new incident sounds an alarm and flashes red until someone takes it; all clear shows green.

apps.name: Open-Meteo
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: The weather now and the coming days from Open-Meteo, free and with no key: temperature, rain, wind, UV and air quality where you are.

apps.name: OpenWeather
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: The weather now, by the hour and the coming days from OpenWeather, with alerts, air quality and UV. Needs your free OpenWeather key.

apps.name: Pixel Arcade
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Worm, Brick Breaker and Comet Dodge: three quick arcade games. Play with the knob, a USB keyboard or mouse, or the phone as a game pad.

apps.name: PR Board
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Your GitHub work at a glance: pull requests waiting for your review, your own pull requests with their reviews and checks, and the issues assigned to you. A new review request gets a chime.

apps.name: Queue Board
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: A queue display for a bank branch or any service counter: the ticket called and its counter in large letters, a chime and a spoken call, each service line's number now serving, how many wait and about how long. Staff call the next ticket with a click or from the phone.

apps.name: Release Countdown
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: A countdown to your next release, code freeze or launch, with the milestones after it, a code freeze sign, and your repository's latest GitHub release and production deploy. Ship day gets a fanfare.

apps.name: Room Sign
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Turns Pixlpal into a meeting-room sign: free or in use, until when, what is on now and next, from the room's calendar. Works with Google, Outlook and any calendar that shares an iCal (.ics) link.

apps.name: RSS Reader
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Headlines from up to seven news feeds you choose: BBC, Al Jazeera, NPR, the Guardian, tech and Nigerian news, or any RSS or Atom feed by its address.

apps.name: Sales Gong
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: The team's goal board: this month's total against the target, whether you're ahead of the pace, and who is leading. Every new deal rings the gong. Reads a Google Sheet published as CSV, any CSV or JSON link, or deals you add from the phone.

apps.name: Scam Alerts
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Fraud-awareness tips for a bank branch, in turn on the screen: never share your PIN or one-time code, there is no safe account, fake calls and links. Add the bank's own tips, and put up an urgent alert about a scam going round now.

apps.name: Scoreboard
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: A scoreboard for the games you play: names and colours, the score from the knob or your phone, a game clock with periods and a buzzer, and the scoring rules of volleyball, table tennis, badminton and tennis built in.

apps.name: Sky Tonight
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Tonight's sky where you are: sunrise and sunset, the moon's phase, the space station passing over, and the chance of the northern lights.

apps.name: Sleep Wind-Down
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: A calmer bedtime: a countdown to the bedtime you choose, a reminder to wind down before it as the panel dims to a warm glow, a dim red clock or darkness at night, and a gentle sunrise light to wake to.

apps.name: Solar Inverter
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Your solar power flow, live: what the panels make, what the house uses, the battery's charge, and whether you are buying from or selling to the grid, with today's energy. For SolarEdge (your key), Fronius, or any inverter or hub that gives JSON.

apps.name: Space Launches
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: A countdown to the next rocket launch anywhere in the world: the rocket, the mission, the pad and whether it is go, with the launches after it. From The Space Devs' Launch Library. No key needed.

apps.name: Stand-up Host
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Runs the team's daily stand-up: it shuffles who speaks when, gives each person the same time with a warning near the end, and moves on at a click. At the end it shows how long the meeting took and who went over.

apps.name: Studio Light
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: The whole panel as a light: a colour, two colours, white for photos and video calls, effects and a sunrise wake light.

apps.name: Team Around the World
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: For teams across time zones: each teammate's local time and whether they are working, off for the evening, asleep, on a weekend or a public holiday, the hours when everyone is at work, and each person's next holiday.

apps.name: Team Tracker
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Your teams beyond football: the live score, the next game and the last result for up to four teams in basketball, American football, rugby, ice hockey, baseball, handball or volleyball. From API-Sports with your free key.

apps.name: Tell the Time
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: For children of 5 to 8: a big clock with the time in words and the family's day, and games to learn the clock: set the hands, read the clock, work out what time it will be. Six levels that follow how your child does.

apps.name: Tides & Water
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: The tide's height and times, the sea and river levels, and alerts, from Open-Meteo, NOAA, Stormglass or WorldTides.

apps.name: Timers
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: A stopwatch with laps, countdown timers and an interval timer, with sounds when they end.

apps.name: Treasure Hunt
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: For children of 5 to 12: a treasure hunt round the house. Write the clues on the phone, hide a card with each clue's code, and children enter each code with the knob to open the next clue.

apps.name: Trivia Night
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: A quiz for one to four players, with questions from the Open Trivia Database on films, science, history, sport and more. Turn the knob to choose an answer, click to lock it in, and see who wins the round. No key needed.

apps.name: Typing Hero
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: For children of 7 to 12: learn to type with ten fingers on a USB keyboard. 13 lessons from the home row to sentences, a falling-letters game, and a one-minute word race.

apps.name: Uptime Monitor
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: Pixlpal checks up to eight websites or web services every few minutes: up or down, how fast they answer, and how often they were up. When one goes down, Pixlpal shows it in red and sounds an alarm.

apps.name: Water & Breaks
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: For your desk: glasses of water against a daily goal (click the knob for each), reminders to stand up and stretch, and 20-20-20 eye breaks for screen work, all within your working hours.

apps.name: World Clock
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: The time in the cities you choose, with day and night, each city's flag and how far ahead or behind it is.

apps.name: World Flags
apps.author: Meterbit Cyb
apps.about: The flags of 270 countries and territories with their capitals and continents: one flag, a slideshow (the world, a continent or your favourites), or a flag quiz.
